Compare A with a scalar or a second tensor.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TensorCompare` |
| Search words | tensor, compare, greater, less, equal, mask |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **A** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Left operand tensor |
| **B** | Tensor | No | 1 | Optional right operand tensor; when connected, Scalar is ignored |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Mask** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Zero-or-one comparison mask matching the input shape |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Comparison | Operator | `op` | Choice | `>` | `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `==`, `!=` | The run | Comparison applied to A and Scalar or A and B. |
| Comparison | Scalar | `scalar` | Number | `0.0` |   | The run | Right operand used when B is not connected. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a scalar tensor mask or graph fan-in comparison layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
